v21_assert_pass.description: Summons one named pig, then asserts its count, the player's dimension and game mode. Expect three ASSERT records with outcome=pass and the end marker.
commands: devtool assert entities count 1 within 12 name v21pig

v21_assert_fail_control.description: Asserts two pigs when there is one. Expect ASSERT outcome=fail with expected=2 observed=1, an ERROR with devtool.assert.failed, and the bundle halting before its second marker.
commands: devtool assert entities count 2 within 12 name v21pig

v21_assert_tolerated.description: The same failing assertion with its key tolerated. Expect outcome=fail in the record but no ERROR, and the end marker present.

commands.command: devtool assert entities count 2 within 12 name v21pig

v21_assert_unloaded.description: Asserts a made-up UUID absent at a position 3000 blocks away that nobody has loaded. Expect outcome=unloaded, regionLoaded=false, an ERROR with devtool.assert.unloaded, and the bundle halting.

v21_assert_absent_loaded.description: The same made-up UUID absent at the player's own position, which is loaded. Expect outcome=pass with observed=absent.

v21_cleanup.description: Removes the pig and stops the session.
